title.zh: 将桑利角海空军训练站的机场命名为Danilo Atienza少校机场的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the Airfield At the Sangley Point Naval and Air Training Station To Major Danilo Atienza Airfield, Sangley Point
title.orig: An Act Naming the Airfield At the Sangley Point Naval and Air Training Station To Major Danilo Atienza Airfield, Sangley Point

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7479_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The airfield at the Sangley Point Naval and Air Training Station is hereby named as Major Danilo Atienza Airfield.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
